The '''E522 assassin droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] series created by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and, later, [[Sienar Intelligence Systems/Legends|Sienar Intelligence Systems]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Empire had outlawed [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] after the [[Caprioril Massacre|massacre]] on [[Caprioril]], but continued to use various models, including the E522 series, in secret for its own ends.

==Characteristics==
The E522 was loaded with weapons and extremely adept at tracking targets. It was fairly compact and moved about on well-oiled treads. It came equipped with a pair of gripper claws and an infrared heat-signature tracking system, making it a decidedly difficult opponent to escape.

==History==
[[File:E522AssassinDroid-SGtD.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An EG522 assassin droid]]
[[Eefive-Tootoo]] was an E522 assassin droid that was once in the employ of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Jabba had Eefive covered in meat juices and fed to the [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]].<ref name="WDDW">{{StoryCite|story=We Don't Do Weddings: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> Eefive was recovered and repaired by two [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], who stripped the droid of its programming and weapons. They sold the droid to [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian]],<ref name="SM">{{StoryCite|story=Swap Meet: The Jawa's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> who employed it as a courier and messenger droid.<ref name="WDDW" />

The gunrunner [[Praaelon Di]] kept an old E522 for protection aboard his ship, the ''[[Tri-Sun]]''.

==Behind the scenes==
There is some conflict over who created the E522 assassin droid. In ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', the E522 is said to have been produced by the Techno Union during the Clone Wars. However, various [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] products state that it was created by Sienar Intelligence Systems around the time of the Galactic Civil War. Both accounts have been used in this article.

The quote that appears on the E522's [[Star Wars Miniatures|miniature]] stat card (and which is featured above) is a parody of [[Wikipedia:Clint Eastwood|Clint Eastwood's]] famous line "''Go ahead, make my day''" from the [[Wikipedia:Dirty Harry (film series)|Dirty Harry]] film [[Wikipedia:Sudden Impact|''Sudden Impact'']].
